title: Paul Tudor Jones Says 2027 Gets Rough, and It's Not About Valuations
speaker: tastylive host (discussing Paul Tudor Jones)

macro_themes.view: PTJ says 2027 will be rough as buybacks stall, capex soars and mega IPOs add supply; host notes buybacks still ~2x new issuance, so the engine is coughing, not stalled.

calls.reason: PTJ bearish on 2027 on equity-supply grounds; host counters with Goldman buyback math and frames options-implied range of ~6,000-9,600 (or 6,600-9,000) by Dec 2027.
calls.quote: Paul Tudor Jones says 2027 will be really, really challenging. His reasoning isn't valuations, it's supply.

notes: PTJ's bearish view is reported second-hand, not a guest appearance; host is neutral, so long_term recorded as mixed. 6,000/9,600 are expected-move bounds, not targets.
